description: The CYBEX Cloud T i-Size Plus Car Seat in Cozy Beige is suitable from birth, providing both comfort and safety for your growing baby up until around 24 months. When used with the ISOFIX Base T, you can enjoy the benefits of an in-car recline position for a comfortable ride every time.    Plus, by turning the infant car seat towards the car door, it's easy to on and off-board your little one due to its 180 rotation. To provide extra leg support, the recline hinges at the hip area and also create a longer seating position for extra space. This makes it one of the longest infant carriers available on the market. The all-around air ventilation allows for a pleasant seating temperature for your little one no matter their age or season.    The Cloud T i-Size Car Seat boasts safe security features, and exceptional flexibility and could be just what you're looking for when travelling with your little one. Whether it’s short trips around town or long car rides across the country, bring them along, safely with comfortable journeys in mind.    The Plus fabric also features mesh inserts for even better air circulation and comfort, proper circulation of air not only reduces humidity but also prevents any excess moisture. Its specially designed 3D mesh structure improves breathability by up to six times*, ensuring that your child stays cool and comfortable no matter the weather.    Please note: The Cloud T fits on the Z2 base as well as the T base, however, Base T is only fit for the T range and is not compatible with any other car seats. This technology includes a recline hinge positioned in the hip area, enabling the backrest to flatten while extending the leg rest. This results in an optimal lying position for your baby, ensuring their utmost comfort.    When used on a pushchair, the Cloud T i-Size can be fully reclined to a lie-flat position, providing ergonomic comfort while on the move. The Lie-Flat Technology plays a vital role by preventing your baby's head from falling forward, promoting unrestricted breathing and supporting the crucial development of their lungs.    Easy On & Off Boarding     With the 180° rotation feature, you have the convenience of swiveling the Cloud T i-Size towards the car door, making on and off-boarding effortless (requires Base T). product_name: bbhugme Pregnancy Pillow- Dusty Pink
description: The bbhugme Pregnancy Pillow helps you to sleep better, get comfortable, and relieve the discomforts of pregnancy. Designed in Norway by health professionals, the firmness of the pillow is adjustable to fit the needs of your changing body, from the first trimester and beyond.    What's included:       Inner pillow filled with ultra-fine microbeads   Washable outer cover   Two Pebbles   Organic cotton travel/storage bag       Key Features:       Developed by Health Professionals Expert-developed   Pressure Relieving   Adjustable firmness   5-point body support   Cooling features   Multi-shaped      Includes an inner pillow filled with ultra-fine microbeads, a washable outer cover, and two Pebbles to adjust the firmness to your preferred level of comfort. The pillow provides 5-point body support and can be used in different positions to relieve pressure and help you sleep better. Organic cotton travel/storage bag included.    User Instructions:    To assemble, pull the cover over the inner pillow and slide a Pebble onto each end. Move the Pebbles to adjust the pillow’s firmness. The pillow provides 5-point body support for side-sleeping and can be shaped into multiple positions. Ideal for use starting in the first trimester and for continued support as a body pillow after pregnancy.    Size and Dimensions:    Length: 140-145cm x Height: 20 cm. Note: These dimensions are for the inner pillow and may vary slightly due to the microbead filling, which is filled to a degree that allows the pillow to be adjusted. Once fully assembled, the pillow's thickness and length can be adjusted based on your desired level of firmness.    Materials:    Do not put the inner pillow in the washing machine. It can be gently cleaned with a wet towel. The outer cover is machine washable on medium heat (40°C). Hang to dry; do not tumble dry. The Pebbles can be washed in the dishwasher or in the sink withwarm water. Store the pillow in the travel bag when not in use.    The inner pillow is filled with ultra-fine EPS microbeads. EPS is a material with natural antibacterial and anti-fungal properties and is tested and certified per applicable standards. The inner pillow fabric is 85% nylon and 15% spandex. The outer cover is spun from 95% cotton and 5% spandex jersey. The Pebbles are made from 100% BPA-free silicone. Our products are Standard 100 by OEKO-TEX Class 1 Certified.    Safety:    The Pregnancy Pillow is for adult use only. Never leave your baby or child unattended with it. Supervision is required by an awake, alert adult. Never let a baby sleep on or with the Pregnancy Pillow. Do not unzip the inner pillow or attempt to remove the microbeads, as they can be a choking hazard for children.

What's included:       Dream Sight™ Camera   Dream Sock® Sensor   Four Fabric Socks - Fits babies 0-18 months, 5-30 lbs / 2.5-13.6 kg   Wireless Charging Base Station   Access to the Owlet® Dream App   Camera Mounting Kit      Key Features:       Medically Certified: Combines medical-grade health tracking with 2K HD video for a full picture of your baby’s well-being—all in one app   Track Live Health Readings: Continuously monitors live pulse rate, oxygen levels, sleep patterns, and room conditions   Know When You’re Needed: Sends real-time alerts if pulse rate or oxygen level leaves pre-set safe zone   Predictive Sleep: Understand your baby’s sleep needs. With predictive sleep tracking and personalised insights, you’ll know when it’s time for rest, making routines smoother and nights more restful.   See & hear your baby clearly: from anywhere with 2K HD video with night vision. Smart sensors detect when your baby moves, cries or makes noise. With strong encryption and secure connection, your video stays private and protected, so every moment stays yours.   View Health & Sleep Trends: Dream Duo connects your Dream Sock monitor and Dream Sight camera through the Dream App.   Clinically validated, trusted by millions: Backed by clinical studies and medically-certified, Owlet has monitored more than 1.7 million babies, tracked over 17 trillion heartbeats, and helped millions of families around the world navigate every age and stage with confidence.   Age Range: For healthy infants 0-18 months, 5-30 lbs / 2.5-13.6 kg   It is recommended to wash the Sock and sensor every 2 weeks to avoid skin irritation caused by an unclean sock and sensor. Simply wash by hand with a mild detergent and lukewarm water.       Intended Use:    Dream Sock® is intended for routine, in-home surveillance of healthy infants by measuring oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulse rate (PR). Dream Sock® software analyses photoplethysmography data to identify instances when the infant’s PR and/or SpO2 moves outside a preset range, and provides a notification to the caregiver, prompting them to assess the infant.    The notifications and associated data are intended to supplement the decision by caregivers to seek additional guidance for medical care of the infant. The feature is not intended to replace traditional methods of diagnosis and/or treatment.    Indications for Use:    Dream Sock® is indicated for use in healthy infants/children ages 0 to 18 months and weighing between 2.5-13.6kg in the home environment. It is not indicated for use with infants previously diagnosed with chronic cardiovascular and/or respiratory conditions.    Dream Sock® is indicated for the detection and notification of hypoxia when measured SpO2 levels fall below 80%, as well as the detection and notification of tachycardia and bradycardia when PR levels are measured above 220 BPM or below 50 BPM, respectively.

With a discreet zipper, the cover can be removed and machine washed at 30˚C. The carrycot also includes a panoramic ventilation panel for climate controlled comfort to keep baby cool, calm and settled on every stroll. When paired with the Cove 2 carrycot stand (sold separately), disturbance-free transfers are simple and comforting, whether you’re settling in at home or away.    Switching between parent-facing and forward-facing positions is quick and easy thanks to the seat’s intuitive memory buttons, while a one-hand recline, adjustable calf support and enhanced padding allow the seat to adapt easily as your child develops. As your child grows, the reversible seat unit with an extendable UPF50+ hood features adjustable hood heights, offering extra room and reliable sun protection.    Cove 2 is finished with coordinated, all-weather fabrics designed for practical everyday use. Anti-crease jersey fabrics are water repellent with a UPF50+ finish, while a new colour-matched harness creates a complementary look. Cove 2’s outer fabrics are removable and machine washable at 30˚C for everyday practicality and longevity.    Cove 2’s practical details extend to parents too. The handlebar adjusts effortlessly with one hand to ensure a comfortable push no matter your height, while the supersized storage basket offers a generous 10kg capacity with easy access from both the front and back – home for all your daily essentials and more!    Heading on a family road trip? For effortless travel from door to destination, the Cove 2 Ultimate 360 Car Seat Bundle includes our lie-flat Glide Plus 360 baby car seat and rotating Base Plus 360. product_name: Silver Cross Reef 2 Special Edition + Glide Plus 360 Travel System- Espresso - Glide Plus 360- Natural Taupe
description: Silver Cross Reef 2 Special Edition is designed with elevated details and purposeful features, bringing a touch of luxury to everyday strolls. The soft jersey fabrics and tonal chassis create a bold and unique aesthetic, while the bamboo-lined carrycot and lie-flat ergonomic seat offer natural comfort from city breaks to countryside escapes. The seat unit includes an ergonomic curved head support for additional baby comfort. The magnetic Genius™ buckle and an auto-adjust harness, allowing for quick height adjustments to support your child without the need to rethread. Crafted for everyday versatility, the puncture-proof multi-terrain wheels and advanced 4-wheel suspension allow for supreme handling across pavements, paths and uneven ground. The multi-height handle, adjustable calf support and one-touch brake add convenience and comfort whether you’re enjoying a coffee or stroll along the high street, whilst the spacious basket provides easy access for everyday essentials.    Completing the travel system is a collection of coordinated accessories, tailored with exceptional fabrics and tonal metallic detailing to create an exquisite design cohesion.
